<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0>About that relic from before —
we finally know whose chalice it is.

It seems to be one for offering
a monster's blood.

Offering a monster's blood,
both giving thanks and mourning it,
was its intent, they say.

A proof that monsters and people
once lived side by side.
